messages:
maria: Heads-up — after the int4 bring-up for qwen-7b and gemma-7b-lite I see a reproducible correlation where certain tokens from GEMMA outputs appear shifted in QWEN responses. Might be a tokenwrap / KV-cache aliasing thing.
ben: Can you paste an example?
maria: Short repro: feed prompt 'List three US states starting with A' to both models after conversion. GEMMA list contains "Alabama, Alaska, Arizona" (ok). QWEN sometimes returns "Alabama, \u0000, Alaska, Arizona" — there's a null/zero token sneaking in after int4 conversion.
alex: Null token (0) is suspicious — could be an EOS/sentinel collision or vocab id remap. Did you check tokenizer outputs before and after conversion?
maria: Yup. Tokenized ids (gemma -> qwen mapping) around the area:
```
gemma ids: [154, 203, 11, 412, 512, 1312]
qwen ids:  [154, 203, 0,   412, 512, 1312]
```
That middle id becomes 0 after our converter script.
ben: Oof. Which converter? the one in tools/tokenmap/convert.py?
maria: Yeah — specifically the stage that folds large vocab offsets into 16-bit slots for the int4 layout. Might be an overflow or signed/unsigned cast.
ci-bot: Deployment note: conversion job #452 finished at 2026-03-18T09:12:04Z (artifact: qwen-gemma-int4.map)
sasha: Quick diff of the map shows a contiguous run where ids > 65520 were wrapped to 0. Looks like the mask in the packer used 16-bit unsigned but then interpreted as signed somewhere.
pranav: I ran an A/B on the 1k eval prompts (open-qa + summarization). Metrics: QWEN-int4 baseline weirdness (token-drop rate) 0.4%. After the new map it jumped to 2.7%. GEMMA-int4 unchanged.
ben: That delta is large. Can you share the exact snippet that reproduces the id wrap?
maria: Sure, running locally:
```
# minimal repro
from tokenmap import load_map, remap_ids
m = load_map('qwen-gemma-int4.map')
ids = [154,203,11,412]
print(remap_ids(ids, m))  # -> [154,203,0,412]
```
The map contains an entry `11 -> 65536` which then gets masked to 0 in the packer.
alex: If the packer uses `uint16` for storage, 65536 -> 0 is exactly the wrap. We should clamp or emit an error during conversion.
sasha: Agree. Quick mitigation: detect any mapping >= 65536 and fail the conversion job. Also add a unit test for edge-case ids.
pranav: Also curious: KV-cache update code assumes token ids fit in 16-bit for our int4 kernels. Is that an invariant we documented? If not, we might need to change the layout to use 32-bit slots or patch the cache translation.
ben: Changing cache layout is invasive. Prefer fixing converter first and adding a guard. If customers have models with IDs above 65535, we'll need a long-term plan.
maria: I'll open a PR to add the guard and a failing test. Proposed steps: 1) revert the bad map in S3, 2) add guard + tests in tools/tokenmap, 3) re-run the 1k A/B.
ben: Assign to @ben for the revert + to @maria for the code change. I'll own the re-run.
ci-bot: CI pipeline triggered for PR #1298: tokenmap: guard against 16-bit wrap (maria).
pranav: One more note — I saw a tiny latency blip when re-encoding maps (0.5% p50). Might be IO bound but worth watching after revert.
sasha: For long term, let's add a conversion audit that reports max mapped id and flags > 65535. Also include a checkbox in onboarding for model vocab size expectations.
alex: For the immediate smoke, @ben can we restore previous map version `qwen-gemma-int4.map:v20260310`?
ben: Yup. Restoring now.
ci-bot: Artifact restored: qwen-gemma-int4.map -> v20260310 (restorer: ben)
maria: After restore, quick sanity: remap_ids now returns [154,203,11,412] as expected. A/B rerun shows weirdness back to 0.45%.
ben: Nice. PR looks good. @maria add the failing case to the tokenmap unit tests and ping me for review.
pranav: And we should scan other converter variants (llama/mistral pathways) for similar unchecked masks. Might be copy/paste.
sasha: I'll run a repo-wide grep for "uint16" in packer/packer.* and list suspicious usages.
ben: Thanks team. Filing follow-up ticket to track long-term layout options (keep 32-bit or split vocab).
maria: TY. Quick follow-up: adding a small smoke that runs the three canonical prompts across onboarded models after any conversion job — will reduce regressions. :thumbsup:
alex: Great. Closing the loop here.
summary: int4 tokenmap conversion wrapped vocab ids >65535 to 0 causing token drops in QWEN-int4; team restored previous map, added guard and tests, plan for audit and longer-term layout review.
